summary: The Backrooms is a multiplayer survival game spanning Level 0, Levels 1–5 and M.E.G. Base Gamma, with authored scenes and place-local simulations assembling spaces, actors and encounters around shared layout, loot, creature and NPC systems. Level 5's Terror Hotel now combines its ballroom and Main Hall with working multi-bank elevators, a staffed resident cast, rented suites and stash storage, and hostile staff and Death Rat encounters.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0's generated yellow maze and safe-room hub; authored cells, loot, shifting walls, seeded moments and smilers/lurkers.
places/level1 (3D) - Habitable Zone and M.E.G. camp; car-park cells, agents, searchable loot, hounds and skin-stealers; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level2 (3D) - Abandoned Utility Halls and Survivor camp; seeded halls, rooms, NPCs, supplies, hounds and Level 3 threshold; grid walls and props are destructible.
places/level3 (3D) - Electrical Station; maze zones/crawl halls, hazards, loot, creature brigades and Gamma checkpoint; breakable walls and powered lifts lead to Levels 4 and 5.
places/gamma (3D) - M.E.G. Base Gamma interior; security hall, atrium/mall, faux town, traders, guards and residents; sim adds the locked Database computer.
places/level4 (3D) - Abandoned Office, a 64×64 m floor with offices, fountains, break-room vending, Level 3 lift, stairs down to Level 5 and Base Omega; sim adds residents, offices and tasks.

places/level5 (3D) - Terror Hotel, a 96×60 m 1930s hotel; authored Main Hall/guest rooms, Beverly Room ballroom and Boiler Room, with sim/scene-managed residents, elevators, hostile staff, Death Rats and suite storage.
places/debug (3D) - isolated combat and loot test room; authored cells hold weapon/item stations, enemy pens and test stands.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer entry at main; declares camera, actions, player template and HUD renderer.
templates/player.js - ordered behavior chain: humanoid-locomotion, player, interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, os, lockpick, horde, critter.
templates/camera.js + scripts/camera.js - camera entry; owns presented yaw/pitch, crouched eye height, computer view, seated eye and third-person death view.

places/<place>/sim.js - local setup/tick roots; Level 4 builds office systems, Level 5 lays hotel shell, lamps, radios and exits; the scene's l5-hall-mgr and l5-heat managers separately lay hall furnishings and run boiler heat.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells - place configuration and authored placements; Level 5 x0z0.scene includes ballroom, hotel NPCs, elevator banks, Boiler managers and l5-people director.
places/level5/config.yaml - Level 5's dark, fogged 3D environment, colored sky, warm ambient light and scripts/look-level5.js post-processing.
scripts/ui.js with loot-ui.js, talk-ui.js, build-ui.js, stats-ui.js, craft-ui.js, os-ui.js, horde-ui.js, noclip-ui.js and lockpick-ui.js - HUD composition, level transition card and action overlays.
shared: scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - shared avatar gait/heading behavior; player and M.E.G. NPC chains run it before their controllers.
scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/data/level0.yml; scripts/lib/level1.js and level2.js with their data - per-level grids/layouts reused by simulation, geometry and gameplay.
scripts/lib/level3.js + scripts/lib/data/level3.yml + scripts/lib/maze3path.js - Electrical Station grid, zones, openings and routes for geometry, sim and creatures.
scripts/lib/level4.js and scripts/lib/level5.js - office/hotel plans, zones, openings, exits and sanity data shared by geometry, place systems and player.js.
scripts/lib/l5-boiler-plan.js - Boiler Room cell coordinates for machines, pipes, leaks, vents and heat parameters; geometry and active scripts/l5-heat.js share it.
scripts/lib/l5-hall-layout.js + scripts/lib/l5-hall-kit.js - Main Hall furnishing/door/fixture data and mesh helpers consumed by l5-hall-lay.js, l5-hall-geo.js and l5-hall-fix.js.
scripts/lib/l5-people.js + scripts/lib/data/level5-people.yml - Level 5 resident definitions, appearance/rounds, speech and shared NPC simulation helpers used by l5-people.js and l5-resident.js.

scripts/lib/l5-hostile.js + scripts/lib/data/l5-entities.json - Level 5 hostile definitions and shared safe-zone, prey, damage, path/position and remains helpers used by l5-staff.js and l5-rats.js; scripts/lib/seat.js remains the shared multi-seat contract.
notableExports: places/*/sim.js - cadence and tick; Level 4 and Level 5 sims also export lay; places/gamma/sim.js also exports PEOPLE.
scripts/lib/level3.js - grid/constants, cell/zone queries, openings, blocks/hazards, crawl spans and exits; maze3path.js - stepToward, cellNear.
scripts/lib/level4.js - office room/zone constants and queries; scripts/lib/level5.js - T, ZONES, OPENINGS, EXITS, ARRIVALS, ELEVATORS, BOILER, facing, zoneAt, DRAIN5, ZONE_NAMES, PLACARDS.
scripts/lib/l5-people.js - PEOPLE5, roundsOf, speak, spawnResident, tickPeople; scripts/l5-elevator.js - destIndex, ears, update; scripts/l5-people.js - updateSchedule, update.
scripts/lib/l5-hostile.js - SND, SAFE, zoneId, isSafe, prey, hit, claimRemains, becomeCorpse, killerOf and shared hostile data E.
scripts/lib/clothes.js - fullLook, rollLevel, leveledRows, rollCloth, npcLook and clothing helpers; scripts/lib/breakables.js - wall/prop damage, sync and sweep helpers.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js - critter model/look/morph helpers; scripts/lib/seat.js - seat claims/sit/stand; scripts/lockpick.js - onInput, update, startPick.
scripts/weapon-geo.js and Level 5 geometry scripts - scripted geometry/collider exports; scripts/l5-heat.js - updateSchedule, update; scripts/l5-stash-geo.js - geometry, collider.
ownership: scripts/player.js - player.state owns level/XP, health/sanity, visited cells/zones, kills/deaths, equipment/inventory/ammo/condition, clothes, compass, crouch, meat and consumable counts/timers; player-local session holds transient combat state.
scripts/stats.js - player.state owns HALOGEN attributes, skills, points, tags, schema version, sheetOpen and target; initializes/migrates the sheet and spends points.
scripts/craft.js - player.state hunger/thirst, craftOpen/craftBench and payout redemption; crafts validate recipe/skill/materials.
scripts/horde.js - player.state horde phase/countdown/alive/result; session holds wave timing; spawned creature state carries the owning player's horde id.
scripts/build.js + scripts/player.js - player.state.scrap and build/buildRot/buildLast selection; session holds preview ghost and forward direction.

scripts/interact.js and scripts/lib/seat.js - focus/loot menu/interaction plus player.state.sit and seat.state.by occupancy claims; NPCs own pockets/picked and per-player warned/angry state; containers own item lists/lock/scavenged state.

scripts/l5-resident.js - concierge writes place.state.l5rent and player suite key/expiry; player.state.l5job/l5rats track clerk's rat contract, while l5-stash.js owns trunk.items, per-renter stash and access checks.

Level 5 elevator cab/panel states own ride phase, request, floor, doors, riders and indicator/UI; l5-rats.js director owns pack phases and light flicker, individual rats/staff own health/death/remains, and l5-heat.js owns vent phases and player heat/hp effects.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js chain: humanoid-locomotion reads prior movement before player writes control; interact, talk, build, noclip, stats, craft, os, lockpick and horde handle ordered actions before critter behavior.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js owns presented yaw/pitch and eye position; player/enemy gaze and targeting consume camera direction/state; seat parenting and sit state lower the seated view.
Level 0 exit in scripts/player.js → Level 1; paired thresholds connect Levels 1–3; Level 3 sim lift → level5#l5-from-l3, Level 4 stairs → level5#l5-from-l4; Level 5 lift/stairs return to Level 3/4.

scripts/level-door.js trigger → paired arrival marker IDs (PAIR) or state.to fallback; Level 3/4/5 sims place inbound markers, and scripts/player.js chooses nearest safe spawn/door checkpoint after death.
scripts/player.js writes player.state.xfer on place change → scripts/ui.js draws named level transition card; level-door.js crossing uses the black transition.

interact.js focus/E on living NPC → player.state.talkWith; talk-ui.js sends text/actions via talk/talkdo/shop inputs to talk.js or NPC ears; handlers write NPC state.line/player subtitle and react to talkopt.

interact.js E → door/container/bench/usable press; Level 4 home/office and Level 5 l5-door/l5-ball/l5-hall-door/stash/elevator handlers own their use cases; E on lockpick-locked target starts lockpick.js and lockpick-ui.js renders it.
Level 4 phone/printer/shift board → l4-office.js tasks and player.state.l4task; completion writes payout, which craft.js redeems and craft-ui.js displays.
Level 5 scene l5-hall-mgr → l5-hall-lay.js reads hall layout and lays furnishings/guest leaves; l5-heat manager → l5-heat.js reads boiler plan, phases vents and writes player heat/hp.

Level 5 l5-people scene director → lib/l5-people.js reads level5-people.yml, spawns/maintains residents and suite trunks/racks; resident ears handle talk cards, rent/checkout, boiler escort, and rat-job start/reward.

Elevator panel press and ui:f*/ui:yes → scripts/l5-elevator.js writes cabin request; cab rides to the indexed bank, updates riders/floor/doors/indicators, and uses l5-elevator.json for floors/timing/sounds/deadly stops.

l5-rats.js pack director reads l5-entities.json and Level 5 zones, spawns/moves rats and counts kills to player.state.l5rats; l5-hostile converts deaths to remains, while l5-corpse-crew lets Odette carry bodies away.
behaviorFamilies: places/main/cells/* - authored fluorescent fixtures and red-zone variants; selected cells add flicker-wall markings, sound and local flicker/light state; Level 5 x0z0.scene groups hotel detail by room tags.

places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/level4-geo.js, level4-detail-geo.js, l4-prop-geo.js and look-level4.js - office base, non-colliding lived-in detail, varied abandoned props and post-processing share the Level 4 plan.
scripts/l4-office.js + scripts/l4-office-geo.js - repeated open-floor cubicle islands, phones and printers vary by placement; manager schedules rings, ambient sounds, office tasks and supply rewards.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + data/level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + data/level5-people.yml - agent round/talk behavior varies by faction, role, voice, look/build and day/night routine.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml - leveled garment lists vary by player/place tier and rarity; faction wardrobes roll for Level 1–4, Gamma and Omega NPCs; Level 5 hand-cast residents retain their authored outfits.

scripts/smilers.js and scripts/lurkers.js - Level 0 pack managers with distinct gaze/light/sanity reactions; scripts/hounds.js and scripts/stealers.js adapt pursuit/disguise behavior to place grids, safe zones and hunt phase.

scripts/l5-hall-lay.js + l5-hall-geo.js/l5-hall-fix.js - Main Hall furniture/fixtures are parameterized by layout rows; placement kind and loot metadata vary geometry, collision, breakability and containers.

Level 5 systems reuse per-bank elevator behavior with copper/modern/freight geometry and destination/role state; l5-staff.js figures share watched/frozen and hunt behavior, while l5-rats.js manages packs, nests, vent outings and swarm responses.
migrationNotes: Grid contracts differ: Level 0 is 56×56 at 4 m with hub cells 26–29; Level 1 is 30×30 at 8 m; Level 2 is 24×24 at 5 m; Level 3 is 26×26 at 4 m; Level 4 is 64×64 m with 8 m-wide, 6 m-deep offices; Level 5 is 96×60 m, x ±48/z ±30.

Level 4 base l4-geo is structural mesh/collider; l4-detail-geo draws ceiling, carpet and wall wear without a collider; l4-prop-geo and l4-office-geo supply repeated placed detail. Scene entries or sim-spawned bodies provide collision.
Level 3 tight cells are 1 m clear width (tightHalf 0.5), 1.6 m springline and 2.15 m crown; tightArms/tightSpans drive structural/detail vaults, and gates/furniture are excluded from crawl halls.

Player behavior order is intentional: humanoid-locomotion.js before player.js, then interact.js, talk.js, build.js, noclip.js, stats.js, craft.js, os.js, lockpick.js, horde.js and critter.js; NPC arrays likewise put locomotion before M.E.G.-agent controllers.

Door IDs are coupled across level-door.js PAIR, place sims' arrival markers and player.js CHECKS; Level 5 routes include l3-lift5 ↔ l5-from-l3 and l4-stairs-down ↔ l5-from-l4, with l5-lift3/l5-stairs-up returning.

Level 5 Main Hall manager l5-hall-mgr lays from PIECES/LEAVES; do not duplicate its room-door leaves. Elevator panel/cab children are coupled by cab/kids IDs and ELEVATORS order; deadly floors and ride timing live in l5-elevator.json.
